claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves Efest IMR 18350 800mAh 8C as a 800mAh preset with a 8C runtime rating.
HKJ's Efest IMR 18350 800mAh review records a red-wrapper V1 revision as flat-top at approximately 18.2 mm x 35.6 mm and a red-wrapper V2 revision as button-top at approximately 18.2 mm x 35.4 mm.

The Efest IMR 18350 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
The exact catalog entry Efest IMR 18350 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2012-12-22 or earlier.

authenticity.summary: Two historical red Efest wrapper revisions are documented, but the catalog entry does not identify which revision is represented or establish the underlying OEM cell.
checks: Identify whether the cell matches the V1 flat-top or V2 button-top red wrapper before applying the corresponding dimensions.
Inspect label layout, wrapper, and terminal against a known-good sample.
Do not infer the underlying OEM cell from Efest branding alone.
